SELECT rf.recommend_feedback_idx AS recommendFeedbackIdx, rf.member_id AS memberId, rf.recommendation_idx AS recommendationIdx, rf.like_yn AS likeYn, rf.dislike_yn AS dislikeYn, rf.created_at AS createdAt,
b.book_idx AS bookIdx, b.book_title AS bookTitle, b.book_author AS bookAuthor,
m.music_idx AS musicIdx, m.music_title AS musicTitle, m.music_artist AS musicArtist, m.music_url AS musicUrl
FROM recommend_feedback rf
INNER JOIN recommendation r ON rf.recommendation_idx = r.recommendation_idx
INNER JOIN book b ON r.book_idx = b.book_idx
INNER JOIN music m ON r.music_idx = m.music_idx
WHERE rf.member_id = #{memberId} AND rf.recommendation_idx = #{recommendationIdx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommend_feedback ( member_id, recommendation_idx, like_yn, dislike_yn ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{recommendationIdx}, #{likeYn}, #{dislikeYn} )

SELECT rf.recommend_fb AS recommendFb, rf.member_id AS memberId, rf.recommendation_idx AS recommendationIdx, rf.like_yn AS likeYn, rf.dislike_yn AS dislikeYn,
b.book_title AS bookTitle, b.book_author AS bookAuthor,
m.music_title AS musicTitle, m.music_artist AS musicArtist, m.music_url AS musicUrl
FROM recommend_feedback rf
INNER JOIN recommendation r ON rf.recommendation_idx = r.recommendation_idx
INNER JOIN book b ON r.book_idx = b.book_idx
INNER JOIN music m ON r.music_idx = m.music_idx
WHERE rf.member_id = #{memberId} AND rf.like_yn = 1
ORDER BY rf.recommend_fb DESC
